scientific_integrity: The all-parameter kernel comparison is reduced to two stated positive-coefficient polynomial identities. The included checker verifies both identities symbolically and checks illustrative finite mass matrices; finite samples are not the proof. A closely relevant historical finite-element source was assessed from its abstract only and remains a residual originality risk.
scientific_limitations: Exact for unit-length, uniform-arclength complete-split metric graphs with m,k>=2 and continuous edgewise affine functions only; does not assert input-optimizer uniqueness, arbitrary graphs or other spline degrees.
title: Sharp \(L^\infty\) projection norms and norming vertices for complete-split metric graphs
